units: <cite ref="Shevuot 41b:12">Shebu. 41ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>פ׳ מעליא הוי</he> it was a real payment of a debt (and not a mere deposit).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:17">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 6b:15">Ab. Zar. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>עכ״ום לענין פ׳ לעולם מיצר</he> the gentile will always grieve over the payment of a debt (whereas the Jew is glad to have rid himself of an obligation).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 13b">B. Mets. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חיישינן לפ׳</he> (in the case of a note of indebtedness being found) we apprehend that payment may have been made (and therefore it must not be returned to the creditor).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:6:2">Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ</cite> <he>אל יהא לך פ׳ אלא מזה</he> you shall be paid only from this (only this portion of my property is pledged).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2">Koh. R. to VII, 2</cite> <he>מדה שיש בה פ׳</he>; <he>מדת פ׳</he> an act of benevolence with which a divine reward is connected.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 180:2">Yalk. Ex. 180</cite> <he>קבל פ׳ מהקב״ה</he> he received payment (was punished) at the hands of God; a. fr.
